meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 对本地安装的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 做健康体检：与最新源码比对，检查配置、插件、命令链接等，输出每条结论都附证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告；只诊断，不改动用户配置。
howto.when: 当用户要求做体检/诊断，提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词，或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我体检一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: 会生成带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: Codex 刚升级后有点怪，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 会检查版本、配置和插件，找出问题。

say.text: 对比本地安装和最新 LazyCodex 源码，看看有没有差异。
say.note: 会同步最新源码并比对漂移。

howto.what_en: Runs a health check on the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install: compares against latest sources, inspects config/plugins/bin links, and outputs an evidence-backed PASS/WARN/FAIL report. Diagnosis only, no mutation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a health check or doctor, mentions LazyCodex, omo-codex, etc., or reports odd Codex behavior after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Do a health check on my LazyCodex installation.
Codex is acting weird after the upgrade—please diagnose.
say_en.note: Checks versions, config, and plugins to find the cause.

say_en.text: Compare my local install with the latest LazyCodex source.
say_en.note: Syncs latest source and checks for drift.
